create_gaussian_kernel: create a JIT-compiled Gaussian kernel function that computes normalized Gaussian values for a tensor given mean and std
build_polynomial_envelope: build a PolynomialEnvelope module with a configurable exponent to apply smooth cutoff to scaled distance tensors
create_gaussian_smearing_basis: create a GaussianSmearing basis expansion module that maps distance values to a fixed number of Gaussian basis functions
build_radial_mlp: build a RadialMLP neural network from a channel list with linear layers, layer normalization, and SiLU activations
test_radial_module_forward: test the forward pass of RadialMLP, PolynomialEnvelope, or GaussianSmearing modules with sample input tensors
